The mode determines how `classes` must be specified:\n  - `tool_calling`: Agentic tool use. Each item in `classes` represents a tool the model can call.\n  - `judge`: LLM-as-judge for scoring outputs against a single metric. `classes` must contain exactly one item.\n  - `decision`: Multi-class decision/classification. Each item in `classes` represents a possible decision label.\n  - `routing`: Route an input between possible destinations. Each item in `classes` represents a route.\n  - `ner`: Named entity recognition. Each item in `classes` represents an entity type to extract.\n  - `regression`: Score an input on a numeric scale. `classes` must contain exactly one item.\n"},"classes":{"type":"array","description":"The classes for the experiment.
